newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-SV SALZBURG WIN AUSTRIAN TITLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SV SALZBURG WIN AUSTRIAN TITLE.

text.p: SV Salzburg clinched the Austrian league title for the third time despite losing 3-1 to Austria Vienna in Saturday's penultimate round of matches.
Salzburg cannot be overhauled after their nearest challengers 1996 title winners Rapid Vienna also lost, 3-0 to Sturm Graz.
Salzburg, whose two previous championship successes came in 1994 and 1995, have 68 points to Rapid's 63.
